title: Social Media Detox
description: Reduce social media usage and reclaim time and attention with mindful consumption and real-world engagement

goals.title: Increase Real Engagement
goals.description: Spend more time on face-to-face interactions

goals.title: Improve Focus
goals.description: Enhance ability to concentrate without distractions

habits.title: No-Phone Morning
habits.description: Don't check phone for first 30 minutes of day

tasks.title: Delete Time-Wasting Apps
tasks.description: Remove apps that consume excessive time

tasks.title: Find Offline Hobbies
tasks.description: Identify activities that don't require screens

warnings: Social media is designed to be addictive
It's normal to feel withdrawal at first
Focus on what you're gaining, not what you're losing
Curate your feed to reduce negativity
fallback_message: I found a social media detox template! This plan will help you reclaim your time and attention from screens.
